note: G2, the anchored re-roll of batch G (art plan). 2026-10-30. One create_1_direction_object job: no size (the 16 x 16 anchors set it, 64 candidates), view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name g2_ground, 10 generations, style_images = 8 approved G1 sprites rendered by scripts/art/anchors.ts (art/ref/anchors_g1/: d_stone_1, d_copper_ore_2, d_iron_ore_2, d_coal_1 = the facet-lifted G1 frame 9 now listed as d_coal_3, d_thrumstone_2, x_l2_spore_pod, b_chute = G1 frame 48, b_shield_wall). PixelLab review object 3c3701c4-51bf-46a2-9e1f-842e5ad4db25 (job 6c338c86-2d02-4b57-9362-5f706abe2955). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/g2/candidates/frame_<i>.png (_slots). Chosen frames were promoted with select_object_frames (tag g2_ground); each src is that object's image, byte-identical to its frame, or a free workbench fix in art/raw/g2/fixed/ (_fix). Every frame came back 100% Apollo, no partial alpha. What the anchors did: the angle, outline and shading stayed on model, but repeated prompts came back as near-copies of each other, and prompts close to an anchor copied it (copper 28 is G1 copper 4, coal 3 is G1 coal 9), so re-rolled deposits are mostly single lumps; they are mixed with G1's spread layouts so no patch reads as a grid of loose items. Sprites here are not listed in g_ground.json (no overrides).
_prompt: description as G1. item_descriptions (the G1 rejects, 1-6 slots each): coal 'black coal lumps with glossy light grey facets and a white glint' in four layouts (15 slots); iron 'slate-grey rock chunks with rust-red iron flecks and pale grey highlights/tops' (9); copper 'half-buried dark brown rock chunks with bright copper-orange veins' (6); thrumstone 'smooth pale grey-green machined pebbles, each with a pale aqua ring groove on top' (6); x_l5_relic 'grey-green carved stone tablet lying flat, one round ring glyph carved in its face, dark green cracks, no glow' (3); x_l4_vent 'a low dark basalt cone with a round black hole in the middle, dull maroon rim, grey soot, no glow' (3); glass shard, mushroom_small ('dull plum-purple caps'), crystal_small (2 each); x_l0_grass 'dry olive-green and tan grass blades' (1); b_crate 'grey steel panels ... one flat company-yellow band across the lid with a white stencil mark' (3); b_lamp 'lamp post ... brass cage around a bright pale-gold bulb on top' (3); sequencer, unloader, chute as G1 (2 each); x_l1_amber 'chunk of brown rock sealed inside glossy translucent amber resin, honey-orange highlights' (3, not in the batch G list: free slots in the same job).
_slots: 0-3 coal (three lumps), 4-7 coal (one large lump), 8-10 coal (four corners), 11-14 coal (packed seam); 15-19 iron (three chunks), 20-23 iron (two rocks, pale tops); 24-29 copper; 30-35 thrumstone; 36-38 x_l5_relic; 39-41 x_l4_vent; 42-43 x_l5_glass_shard; 44-45 x_l2_mushroom_small; 46-47 x_l3_crystal_small; 48 x_l0_grass; 49-51 b_crate; 52-54 b_lamp; 55-56 b_sequencer; 57-58 b_unloader; 59-60 b_chute; 61-63 x_l1_amber.

sprites.name: d_iron_ore_1
sprites.note: One slate-grey rock with rust flecks and a pale grey top: the variant that carries iron on the dark L2-L5 beds (43 px at 3:1). A single lump (12x10), mixed with G1's lump-with-chips and four-corner layouts.

sprites.name: d_copper_ore_1
sprites.note: One dark brown rock with two bright copper S-veins (12x10); varies the patch next to the G1 diagonal-vein and four-corner layouts.

sprites.name: d_coal_1
sprites.note: Two coal lumps with glossy #819796 facets and small bits: 18 px at 3:1 on the L1/L5 beds, 26 on L2-L4.

sprites.name: d_coal_2
sprites.note: Three black coal lumps with grey highlights and two bits, spread across the tile (4-7 px at 3:1 on the beds).

sprites.name: d_thrumstone_3

sprites.name: x_l0_grass

sprites.name: x_l1_amber

sprites.note: Two mushrooms with dull plum caps and pale stems. Its one #df84a5 pink highlight (a glowcap colour) was mapped to plum #7a367b (free workbench map_colors of art/raw/g2/x_l2_mushroom_small.png).

sprites.name: x_l3_crystal_small

sprites.name: x_l4_vent
sprites.note: Low basalt cone with a black opening and a dull maroon rim, no glow.

sprites.name: x_l5_relic

sprites.name: b_crate

sprites.name: b_unloader
